en-US.author: CAST AI Group, Inc.
en-US.description: A terminal coding agent powered by multi-model orchestration.
en-US.longDescription: Kimchi is a terminal coding agent that routes tasks to different large language models by role, such as orchestrator, builder, reviewer, and explorer, through its multi-model orchestration.
en-US.name: Kimchi
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
New Features
- feat(pr-status): follow the worktree a session's commands run in by @castabar in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1514
- feat(region): make the EU region selectable without the experimental flag by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1428
- feat(guardrails): render guardrail refusals as a notice, not an error by @mszostok in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1674
Bug Fixes
- fix(todos): collapse todo check-in gate blocks into one transcript line by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1662
- fix: remove the timing assumptions behind the flaky tests found in five days of CI by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1671
- fix(thinking): stop re-deriving the full thinking text on every streaming update by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1645
- fix(todos): never deliver the check-in reminder ahead of the user's message by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1655
Other Changes
- fix(language): escape the hint's closing marker and fix the "auto" shadow warning by @Mahamadou828 in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1647
- fix(documents): keep jszip from dating folder entries by wall-clock time by @mikeflame in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1669
- feat(agent-discovery): add claude-desktop import source by @kuchmenko in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1657
- hidding lsp by default - still available for opt in user by @Mahamadou828 in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1661
New Contributors
- @mikeflame made their first contribution in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1669
- @kuchmenko made their first contribution in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1657
Full Changelog: https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/compare/v1.28.3...v1.29.0

zh-CN.description: 由多模型编排驱动的终端编码代理。
zh-CN.longDescription: Kimchi 是一款终端编码代理，通过多模型编排按角色（编排者、构建者、审查者、探索者等）将任务路由到不同的大语言模型。
